author: Athul Prem
scope: Fixed-property nominal Ge and a finite-discrete SAFE section at 1 GHz. Phase indicators are |delta k| times distance in a uniform lead. The 16.65 micrometre value is a uniform-equivalent diagnostic over the device length. The study provides neither a continuum error bound nor patterned-device scattering.
matching: For each signed-power direction separately, interpolate componentwise P2 displacement to the refined section, then assign one-to-one by normalized section mass overlap.
complex_encoding: [real, imaginary]. Portable displacement order is [component, scalar DOF, mode, complex pair]. A negative conjugate alias requires exact field and opposite-wavenumber equality.

inputs.extraction_provenance: Port of the existing h160 patterned-device scattering run.

body_mesh_preflight.scope: Candidate with 12 width cells and four thickness layers. No mechanical assembly or scattering solve.
